name: hireconnect.io
description: HireConnect - MERN-Stack Job and Recruitment Platform

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const files=['_nuxt/admin-engine.js','_nuxt/profile-engine.js','_nuxt/talent-match-engine.js','_nuxt/sign-in-engine.js','_nuxt/sign-up-engine.js','_nuxt/settings-engine.js','find-jobs-engine.js','shared-account-menu.js'];for(const f of files){if(!fs.existsSync(f))throw new Error('Missing bundle: '+f);require('child_process').execSync('node -c \"'+f+'\"');}console.log('Frontend build verification: All bundle assets verified.');"
